title: mguTweaks
description: A simple resource pack to make Mob Griding Utils less annoying.
body:
Minor tweaks to Mob Grinding Utils to make it less annoying. Use with [mob16x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mob16x) for the full effect.

### Features
- Solid XP Block bounce sound is a normal slime sound now
- Using Cursed GM Chicken Feed now plays a note block cover of "Happy Birthday" instead of people yelling "Happy Birthday Dot Co!"
